newsitem.title: CANADA: Northstar to oppose Gulf application.
newsitem.headline: Northstar to oppose Gulf application.

text.p: Northstar Energy Corp said it would oppose Gulf Canada Resources Ltd's application to the Alberta Energy and Utilities Board regarding natural gas production from properties that Northstar operated in the Surmont area of northeastern Alberta.

Northstar said the Gulf application requested that natural gas production from those lands overlying Gulf's oilsands leases be shut in pending determination by the EUB of production and development issues affecting the petroleum and natural gas leases and the underlying oilsands leases.
Northstar chief executive John Hagg said the application could ultimately have an effect on many natural gas producers in the province but would not affect Northstar's cash flow.

"An interruption in Northstar's natural gas production at Surmont caused by the application would not have a material adverse effect on Northstar's cash flow since this area represents less than four percent of Northstar's total production revenues," said Hagg.
